verses.en: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
verses.pt: Filho meu, atende à minha sabedoria; inclinão teu ouvido à minha prudência;
verses.en_web: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding:
verses.en_bbe: My son, give attention to my wisdom; let your ear be turned to my teaching:

verses.en: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.pt: para que observes a discrição, e os teus lábios guardem o conhecimento.
verses.en_web: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: So that you may be ruled by a wise purpose, and your lips may keep knowledge.

verses.en: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
verses.pt: Porque os lábios da mulher licenciosa destilam mel, e a sua boca e mais macia do que o azeite;
verses.en_web: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
verses.en_bbe: For honey is dropping from the lips of the strange woman, and her mouth is smoother than oil;

verses.en: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.
verses.pt: mas o seu fim é amargoso como o absinto, agudo como a espada de dois gumes.
verses.en_web: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.en_bbe: But her end is bitter as wormwood, and sharp as a two-edged sword;

verses.en: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
verses.pt: Os seus pés descem à morte; os seus passos seguem no caminho do Seol.
verses.en_web: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.
verses.en_bbe: Her feet go down to death, and her steps to the underworld;

verses.en: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.
verses.pt: Ela não pondera a vereda da vida; incertos são os seus caminhos, e ela o ignora.
verses.en_web: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.
verses.en_bbe: She never keeps her mind on the road of life; her ways are uncertain, she has no knowledge.

verses.en: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, filhos, dai-me ouvidos, e não vos desvieis das palavras da minha boca.
verses.en_web: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to me then, my sons, and do not put away my words from you.

verses.en: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
verses.pt: Afasta para longe dela o teu caminho, e não te aproximes da porta da sua casa;
verses.en_web: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
verses.en_bbe: Go far away from her, do not come near the door of her house;

verses.en: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
verses.pt: para que não dês a outros a tua honra, nem os teus anos a cruéis;
verses.en_web: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
verses.en_bbe: For fear that you may give your honour to others, and your wealth to strange men:

verses.en: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
verses.pt: para que não se fartem os estranhos dos teus bens, e não entrem os teus trabalhos na casa do estrangeiro,
verses.en_web: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.
verses.en_bbe: And strange men may be full of your wealth, and the fruit of your work go to the house of others;

verses.en: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
verses.pt: e gemas no teu fim, quando se consumirem a tua carne e o teu corpo,
verses.en_web: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
verses.en_bbe: And you will be full of grief at the end of your life, when your flesh and your body are wasted;

verses.en: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
verses.pt: e digas: Como detestei a disciplina! e desprezou o meu coração a repreensão!
verses.en_web: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
verses.en_bbe: And you will say, How was teaching hated by me, and my heart put no value on training;

verses.en: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
verses.pt: e não escutei a voz dos que me ensinavam, nem aos que me instruíam inclinei o meu ouvido!
verses.en_web: neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
verses.en_bbe: I did not give attention to the voice of my teachers, my ear was not turned to those who were guiding me!

verses.en: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
verses.pt: Quase cheguei à ruína completa, no meio da congregação e da assembléia.
verses.en_web: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”
verses.en_bbe: I was in almost all evil in the company of the people.

verses.en: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
verses.pt: Bebe a água da tua própria cisterna, e das correntes do teu poço.
verses.en_web: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.
verses.en_bbe: Let water from your store and not that of others be your drink, and running water from your fountain.

verses.en: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
verses.pt: Derramar-se-iam as tuas fontes para fora, e pelas ruas os ribeiros de águas?
verses.en_web: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?
verses.en_bbe: Let not your springs be flowing in the streets, or your streams of water in the open places.

verses.en: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.
verses.pt: Sejam para ti só, e não para os estranhos juntamente contigo.
verses.en_web: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.
verses.en_bbe: Let them be for yourself only, not for other men with you.

verses.en: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
verses.pt: Seja bendito o teu manancial; e regozija-te na mulher da tua mocidade.
verses.en_web: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
verses.en_bbe: Let blessing be on your fountain; have joy in the wife of your early years.

verses.en: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
verses.pt: Como corça amorosa, e graciosa cabra montesa saciem-te os seus seios em todo o tempo; e pelo seu amor sê encantado perpetuamente.
verses.en_web: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.
verses.en_bbe: As a loving hind and a gentle doe, let her breasts ever give you rapture; let your passion at all times be moved by her love.

verses.en: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
verses.pt: E por que, filho meu, andarias atraído pela mulher licenciosa, e abraÇarias o seio da adúltera?
verses.en_web: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?
verses.en_bbe: Why let yourself, my son, go out of the way with a strange woman, and take another woman in your arms?

verses.en: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
verses.pt: Porque os caminhos do homem estão diante dos olhos do Senhor, o qual observa todas as suas veredas.
verses.en_web: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
verses.en_bbe: For a man's ways are before the eyes of the Lord, and he puts all his goings in the scales.

verses.en: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
verses.pt: Quanto ao ímpio, as suas próprias iniqüidades o prenderão, e pelas cordas do seu pecado será detido.
verses.en_web: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.
verses.en_bbe: The evil-doer will be taken in the net of his crimes, and prisoned in the cords of his sin.

verses.en: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.pt: Ele morre pela falta de disciplina; e pelo excesso da sua loucura anda errado.
verses.en_web: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
verses.en_bbe: He will come to his end for need of teaching; he is so foolish that he will go wandering from the right way.
